issues.legal_issue: A gift deed conveying the donor’s stated share in a described pool of property transfers that entire interest when the interest is later allotted specific properties through partition.
material_facts: The deed listed the properties in the larger property pool and stated that the donor owned a one-sixth share in those properties.
The deed stated that the donor’s one-sixth share was being gifted to the donee.
Before the gift, a partition had allotted part of the property pool to the donor and his brother; a later partition allotted the donor’s interest in specific properties.
The revenue records had not been updated to reflect the earlier partition when the deed was executed.
The courts below disagreed on whether the deed covered the donor’s entire interest or only one-sixth of the specific properties later allotted to him.
issues.conclusion: The deed conveyed the donor’s entire interest in the described property pool, which was later represented by the specific properties allotted to him. The appeal was allowed.
issues.legal_principle: A deed must be read as a whole, with its recitals and operative words considered together to determine the donor’s intention and the property conveyed. Where the deed identifies the property pool, states the donor’s fractional interest in that pool, and gifts that interest, the gift is of the donor’s whole stated interest, not merely the same fraction of property later allotted to the donor. A later partition that identifies the donor’s share in specific properties does not reduce the interest conveyed.

rule.if: gift_deed_construction_appeal and deed_identifies_property_pool and donor_declares_fractional_interest_in_pool and deed_gifts_declared_interest and later_partition_identifies_donors_interest

predicates.gift_deed_construction_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning the construction of a gift deed.
predicates.deed_identifies_property_pool: The deed describes the pool of property in which the donor holds an interest.
predicates.donor_declares_fractional_interest_in_po: The deed states the donor’s fractional interest in the described property pool.
predicates.deed_gifts_declared_interest: The deed states that the donor gifts the declared interest to the donee.
predicates.later_partition_identifies_donors_intere: A partition later identifies the donor’s interest in specific property.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a gift deed that identifies a property pool, states and gifts the donor’s fractional interest in that pool, and that interest is later identified in specific property through partition, the gift covers the donor’s entire partitioned interest.

issues.legal_issue: A claim that a gift deed was nominal may be rejected when the courts below have already rejected that claim and no merit is shown in its renewed assertion.
material_facts: The plaintiff had argued at trial that the gift deed was nominal.
Three courts had rejected that contention.
The contention was faintly revived on appeal, and the Court found no merit in it.
issues.conclusion: The Court rejected the contention that the deed was nominal.
issues.legal_principle: The Court stated that the renewed contention had no merit and noted that three courts had already rejected it; it relied on no cited provision or earlier case for this conclusion.

predicates.appeal_revisits_nominal_gift_claim: The appeal renews a claim that the gift deed was nominal.
predicates.lower_courts_rejected_claim: The courts below rejected the claim that the gift deed was nominal.
predicates.no_merit_shown_for_revival: The renewed claim is not shown to have merit on appeal.

issues.definition: When an appeal renews a nominal-gift claim that the courts below rejected and the renewed claim is not shown to have merit, the claim is rejected.
